title: Senior Analyst, Mandiant Threat Intelligence Services
job_description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:

Remote locations: Virginia, USA; Massachusetts, USA; New York, USA.
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
5 years of experience in a customer-facing analytical role in cyber security (e.g. Network Forensics Analyst, Threat Intelligence Analyst).
Experience working with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders.
Experience building Agentic AI systems, including AI threats, vulnerabilities, and security mitigation.


Preferred qualifications:
7 years of experience evaluating forensic reports of electronic media, packet capture, log data, malware triage, or enterprise-level information security operations.

Experience with Google and other industry AI/LLM tools and resources, major developments affecting AI/LLM, and critical threats and vulnerabilities to AI/LLM.
Experience communicating complex technical findings regarding AI security threats, vulnerabilities, and incident response insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences, verbally and in writing.
Experience leveraging Agentic AI and building agents.
Strong leadership, communication, teamwork and people management skills.
About the job

Mandiant is a recognized leader in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence and incident response services. By scaling decades of frontline experience, Mandiant helps organizations to be confident in their readiness to defend against and respond to cyber threats. Mandiant Threat Intelligence Services is a part of Google’s Threat Intelligence Group under Google Cloud.

Advanced Intelligence Access (AIA) is Mandiant’s premium cyber threat intelligence subscription, offering customers access to a wide range of Mandiant data, tooling, and expertise via a dedicated Mandiant employee, providing support within the customer’s network. AIA is tailored to the needs of each customer, allowing for improved integration and outcomes.

As a Senior Analyst, you will be the primary Mandiant representative supporting a financial technology focused customer with the goal of developing, supporting, maintaining, and driving partnership between Google and the customer by leveraging Mandiant Threat Intelligence portfolio, expertise, and advocacy. You will be an expert at balancing priorities, and demonstrate your efficient communication skills as well as familiarity with the customer’s key priorities. You will work directly with clients to understand their intelligence concerns, unique AI threat-related requirements, and build the partnership between relevant customers and Google stakeholders.

Part of Google Cloud, Mandiant is a recognized leader in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence and incident response services. Mandiant's cybersecurity expertise has earned the trust of security professionals and company executives around the world. Our unique combination of renowned frontline experience responding to some of the most complex breaches, nation-state grade threat intelligence, machine intelligence, and the industry's best security validation ensures that Mandiant knows more about today's advanced threats than anyone.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $138000 - $200000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
Responsibilities
Partner with enterprise customers to embed Mandiant Threat Intelligence directly into their security operations, SIEM, and TIP environments.
Analyze bespoke customer data and raw multi-source telemetry to uncover threat activity, generate high-fidelity CTI, and automate analytical workflows.
Transform complex technical findings into actionable reports and briefings tailored for both frontline security analysts and executive leadership.
Empower customer SOC analysts on CTI workflows while facilitating seamless collaboration across client stakeholders, internal teams, and Mandiant partners.
Identify, assess, and advocate for mitigation strategies around unique security vulnerabilities and emerging threats within AI/ML systems.
